subject: Discovery recap + quick two-line verdict?
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next step suggestions

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so it’s easy to share internally: 

- Goal: reduce inference cost and 95th-pct latency for Bluewave’s table extraction pipeline (current ops: 3x GPUs, p95 ~320ms).
- Proposed immediate play: pilot Redwood Dedicated on inferred workload with KV-cache + per-route batching to test latency gains and cost delta.
- Success metrics we agreed on: p95 < 200ms and >=30% cost/throughput improvement vs current baseline over 2 weeks.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Bluewave shares a short sample trace (anonymized) + expected QPS window;
2) We spin a 2-week pilot on a reserved pool and run a joint runbook;
3) Weekly sync during pilot (15m) + a final decision readout.

Attached: short recap PDF and a one-slide quick proposal (deck-redwood-quick-proposal.pdf) that outlines pilot scope and estimated commit.

If that captures it, would you be open to a one-line reply with either: “Yes — send sample” or “Not a fit” so we can prioritize the queue?

If helpful, I’m free to pull Ben in to walk through telemetry requirements — proposed slots: Tue 11–11:30am PT or Wed 2–2:30pm PT.

Thanks,
Ava
